svg.aria-label: The land skill. Boxes: The step's agents stopped (a step of the session); landing: cherry-picking set, the verify list compared with the page (a step of the session); land.sh: the wip commit, the cherry-pick, the ledger restored, the verify list on main (script); A lock held (stop); A red line for the user (stop); A rule clash (stop); The look and the A/B, where configured (a step of the session); The booking, the state file, the landing report (a step of the session); The commit by explicit path (a step of the session); The worktree and branches removed (a step of the session); A worktree that cannot be removed (stop).
